source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The cached-calendar add failure callback supplies item.calendar, ADD, and item.id; modify supplies oldItem.calendar, MODIFY, and oldItem.id. The 2024 patch replaces null fields, which otherwise break later use of calendar.name when a provider is unavailable. Keep the same callback shape on success, offline fallback, and rejected provider operations. Current source retains it.
title: Preserve calendar, operation type, and item ID in cache failure callbacks
